name: Schematiq
author: mtblabs

sections.description:
Schematiq makes it easy to add structured data (schema markup) to your WordPress site without touching any code. Help search engines understand your content and unlock rich results in Google Search.

Free Version Features:

  • LocalBusiness Schema – Perfect for local businesses, stores, restaurants
  • Organization Schema – For companies, charities, and organizations
  • FAQ Schema – Add FAQ rich results using global settings
  • Per-Page Controls – Enable/disable schema on individual pages
  • Clean Output – All schemas combined in a single @graph for optimal performance
  • Google Validated – Output tested with Google’s Rich Results Test
  • SEO Plugin Integration – One-click option to disable schema from Yoast, Rank Math, and All in One SEO to avoid duplicates
  • Copy from Local Business – On the Organization tab, copy name, logo, contact details and more from Local Business in one click

Want More?

Upgrade to Schematiq Pro for additional schema types including Service, Product, Event, Article, per-page Service fields, and per-page FAQ items.

Why Schema Markup Matters:

Schema markup helps search engines understand your content, which can lead to:
* Rich snippets in search results (stars, FAQs, business info)
* Better click-through rates
* Improved local SEO
* Enhanced knowledge panel information

Easy Setup:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Schematiq in your WordPress admin
  3. Enable the schema types you need
  4. Fill in your business information
  5. That’s it! Schema markup is automatically added to your pages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the schematiq folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Schematiq’ in your admin menu to configure
sections.faq:
Does this work with Yoast SEO?

Yes. In the Overview tab you can enable “Disable schema from other SEO plugins” to turn off schema output from Yoast, Rank Math, and All in One SEO so Schematiq is your single source. You can also leave it off and manage duplicates in the other plugin.

Will this guarantee rich results?

Adding schema markup makes your site eligible for rich results, but Google decides whether to display them. Proper schema markup significantly improves your chances.

Can I add schema to specific pages only?

Yes! Use the Schematiq meta box on any page or post to enable/disable schema for that specific page. The free version supports enabling FAQ schema per-page (using global FAQs). Per-page Service schema and custom FAQ items are available in Pro.

Is the output valid?

Yes, all schema output is tested with Google’s Rich Results Test tool.

  • Security improvements: Added capability checks and proper escaping
  • Internationalization: All user-facing strings are now translatable
  • Code quality: Improved sanitization and validation
  • WordPress.org compliance: Fixed coding standards issues

  • LocalBusiness schema support
  • Organization schema support
  • FAQ schema support (global settings)
  • Per-page FAQ enable/disable toggle
  • Per-page disable all schema toggle
  • Combined @graph output
